<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Build script for Yggdrasil JSX Transpiler (Windows / PowerShell).

.DESCRIPTION
    Wraps clang++ invocations for developers who prefer PowerShell over make.
    Supports Debug, Release, and Test modes.

.PARAMETER Mode
    Build mode: Debug | Release | Clean | Test (default: Debug)

.PARAMETER Run
    After a successful build, run the transpiler with these arguments.
    Example: .\build.ps1 -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"

.EXAMPLE
    .\build.ps1
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Release
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Test
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Debug -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"
#>

param(
    [ValidateSet("Debug","Release","Clean","Test")]
    [string]$Mode = "Debug",

    [string]$Run = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$Root      = $PSScriptRoot
$SrcDir    = Join-Path $Root "src"
$IncDir    = Join-Path $Root "include"
$BuildDir  = Join-Path $Root "build"
$BinDir    = Join-Path $Root "bin"
$Target    = Join-Path $BinDir "yggdrasil.exe"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compiler settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$CXX       = "clang++"
$BaseFlags = @("-std=c++17", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic", "-I$IncDir")

$ModeFlags = switch ($Mode) {
    "Debug"   { @("-g", "-O0", "-DDEBUG", "-fsanitize=address,undefined") }
    "Release" { @("-O2", "-DNDEBUG") }
    default   { @() }
}

$CXXFlags = $BaseFlags + $ModeFlags

$LDFlags = if ($Mode -eq "Debug") {
    @("-fsanitize=address,undefined")
} else {
    @()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Checked {
    param([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args)
    Write-Host "> $Exe $($Args -join ' ')" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    & $Exe @Args
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Error "Command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE"
    }
}

function Get-Sources {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $SrcDir -Filter "*.cpp" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Clean") {
    Write-Host "Cleaning build artefacts..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    if (Test-Path $BuildDir) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BuildDir }
    if (Test-Path $BinDir)   { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BinDir   }
    Write-Host "Done." -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test (run fixture tests without rebuilding if binary exists)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Test") {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Target)) {
        Write-Host "Binary not found — building first (Debug)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        & $PSCommandPath -Mode Debug
    }
    Write-Host "=== Running fixture tests ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $pass = 0; $fail = 0
    $fixtures = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $Root "tests\fixtures") -Filter "*.jsx" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($jsx in $fixtures) {
        $expectedPath = [IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($jsx.FullName, ".expected.js")
        if (-not (Test-Path $expectedPath)) { continue }
        $actual   = & $Target $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String
        $expected = Get-Content $expectedPath -Raw
        if ($actual.TrimEnd() -eq $expected.TrimEnd()) {
            Write-Host "  PASS: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green
            $pass++
        } else {
            Write-Host "  FAIL: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host "  -- expected --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $expected
            Write-Host "  -- actual --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $actual
            $fail++
        }
    }
    Write-Host "Results: $pass passed, $fail failed" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit ($fail -gt 0 ? 1 : 0)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BuildDir | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BinDir   | Out-Null

$sources = Get-Sources
$objects = @()

Write-Host "=== Compiling ($Mode) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

foreach ($src in $sources) {
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($src)
    $obj  = Join-Path $BuildDir "$name.o"
    $objects += $obj
    Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + @("-c", "-o", $obj, $src))
}

Write-Host "=== Linking ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + $LDFlags + @("-o", $Target) + $objects)

Write-Host "Built: $Target" -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: run after build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Run -ne "") {
    Write-Host "=== Running ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-Checked $Target @($Run)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Fixture test runner for Yggdrasil.

.DESCRIPTION
    Two fixture conventions are supported:
      *.jsx + *.expected.js   — transpiler output must equal the .expected.js file
      *.jsx + *.expected_exit — transpiler must exit with the code in that file (error tests)

.PARAMETER Binary
    Path to the yggdrasil binary. Defaults to bin\yggdrasil.exe relative to repo root.

.PARAMETER Filter
    Optional glob filter on fixture base names, e.g. "01_*" or "err_*".
#>
param(
    [string]$Binary = "",
    [string]$Filter = "*"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoRoot    = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..") | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path
$FixturesDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot "tests\fixtures"

if ($Binary -eq "") {
    $Binary = Join-Path $RepoRoot "bin\yggdrasil.exe"
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Binary)) {
    Write-Error "Binary not found: $Binary`nBuild first with: .\build.ps1"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ANSI colour helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Green  { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Green  -NoNewline }
function Red    { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Red    -NoNewline }
function Yellow { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Yellow -NoNewline }
function Cyan   { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Cyan   -NoNewline }
function Nl     { Write-Host "" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diff helper — show first divergence
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Show-Diff {
    param([string]$Expected, [string]$Actual)
    $expLines = $Expected -split "`n"
    $actLines = $Actual   -split "`n"
    $max = [Math]::Max($expLines.Count, $actLines.Count)
    $shown = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $max -and $shown -lt 8; $i++) {
        $e = if ($i -lt $expLines.Count) { $expLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        $a = if ($i -lt $actLines.Count) { $actLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        if ($e -ne $a) {
            Yellow "    line $($i+1):`n"; Nl
            Green  "      expected: $e"; Nl
            Red    "      actual  : $a"; Nl
            $shown++
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Collect fixtures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$jsxFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $FixturesDir -Filter "$Filter.jsx" |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^err_" -or $_.Name -match "^err_" } |
            Sort-Object Name

$pass = 0
$fail = 0
$skip = 0

Write-Host ""
Cyan "=== Yggdrasil Fixture Tests ==="; Nl
Write-Host "  Binary  : $Binary"
Write-Host "  Fixtures: $FixturesDir"
Write-Host "  Filter  : $Filter"
Write-Host ""

foreach ($jsx in $jsxFiles) {
    $base        = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($jsx.FullName)
    $expectedJs  = Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected.js"
    $expectedExit= Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected_exit"

    # ---- Error-exit test ----
    if (Test-Path $expectedExit) {
        $wantExit = (Get-Content $expectedExit -Raw).Trim()
        $output   = & $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1
        $gotExit  = $LASTEXITCODE
        if ([string]$gotExit -eq $wantExit) {
            Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $pass++
        } else {
            Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit, want=$wantExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $fail++
        }
        continue
    }

    # ---- Output comparison test ----
    if (-not (Test-Path $expectedJs)) {
        Yellow "  SKIP"; Write-Host " (no .expected.js) $($jsx.Name)"
        $skip++
        continue
    }

    $expected = (Get-Content $expectedJs -Raw).TrimEnd()
    $actual   = (& $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String).TrimEnd()
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$exitCode] $($jsx.Name)"
        Write-Host "    stderr: $actual"
        $fail++
        continue
    }

    if ($actual -eq $expected) {
        Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        $pass++
    } else {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        Show-Diff $expected $actual
        $fail++
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Cyan "Results: "; Nl
Green  "  $pass passed"; Nl
if ($fail -gt 0)  { Red    "  $fail failed"; Nl }
if ($skip -gt 0)  { Yellow "  $skip skipped"; Nl }
Write-Host ""

exit ($fail -gt 0 ? 1 : 0)

## **4. Current Limitations & Design Decisions**

### **Known Limitations:**

1. **Parameter Destructuring:**
   - Patterns stored as raw text; no semantic understanding of nested destructure
   - Default values appended to parameter name string

2. **JSX Attribute Names:**
   - Only simple identifiers supported (not `data-x` or other dash-separated names)
   - Comment notes this as MVP limitation

3. **Template Literals:**
   - Entire template (raw content with `${}`) stored in single `value` field
   - Lexer tracks nesting depth but parser doesn't parse expressions inside templates

4. **Regex Disambiguation:**
   - Context-sensitive via `lastKind_` heuristic (not perfect but covers most cases)

5. **Error Recovery:**
   - Single-error parse model; first error throws, stops parsing
   - No multi-error collection or recovery strategies

6. **Comments:**
   - Lexer strips all comments (no preservation for output)

7. **Source Maps:**
   - Line/col tracked in tokens and AST but no source map generation

8. **Indentation:**
   - Fixed 2-space indent (configurable in CodeGen constructor, but no CLI flag)

### **Design Decisions:**

1. **Flat Node Structure:**
   - Single `Node` struct with union-like field layout (all fields present, unused zeroed)
   - Avoids deep inheritance hierarchies and virtual dispatch overhead
   - Trade-off: more memory per node, but simpler to work with

2. **Destructuring as Raw Text:**
   - Parameters/var patterns captured verbatim from token stream
   - Allows re-emission without full semantic parsing of nested structures

3. **JSX Mode Stack:**
   - Lexer self-manages mode via push/pop on specific tokens
   - Enables context-aware tokenization (e.g., `<` is JSXLess in expression context, Less elsewhere)

4. **Brace Depth Tracking:**
   - Parallel `jsxBraceDepth` stack allows lexer to close JSX expressions at correct `}`
   - Handles nested braces inside JSX expression containers

5. **No Pragma System:**
   - No directive comments (like `/* @jsx React.createElement */`) for alternate render functions
   - Always emits `React.createElement()`

6. **String Escaping in CodeGen:**
   - JSXText collapsed to single spaces; inline spacing preserved (e.g., `"Hello "` kept)
   - Trailing space on newline-terminated text is trimmed
